rv.q: 1984 succeeds in bringing new life to Orwell’s work; I left the Playhouse thoroughly removed from myself.

Headlong’s sharp, atmospheric adaptation of Orwell’s satire on 1948 follows the sequence of the novel and incorporates recognisable portions of Orwell’s text in the dialogue, but makes it seem like a disturbing image of our near future.

cn.t: Icke and Macmillan's stylish adaptation breathes new life into Orwell's classic with visceral staging and strong performances, though its jolting intensity may prove extreme for some viewers.
